Code of Virginia
Title 18.2. Crimes and Offenses Generally
9/15/2026

§ 18.2-32. First and second degree murder defined; punishment.

Murder by poison, lying in wait, imprisonment, starving, or by any willful, deliberate, and premeditated killing is murder of the first degree.

Code of Virginia
Title 18.2. Crimes and Offenses Generally
9/15/2026

§ 18.2-119. Trespass after having been forbidden to do so.

If any person without authority goes upon or remains upon the lands, buildings, or premises of another after having been forbidden to do so, he is guilty of a trespass.
